design_philosophy: Pure monochrome black and white. Vibrant visual impact achieved purely through kinetic typography, extreme contrast, glassmorphism, luminous white glows, motion, and silver/chrome metallic depth. No colors. Resolve tension by embracing greyscale depth.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] leading-none tracking-tighter uppercase font-black
scales.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl leading-tight tracking-tight font-bold

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300 relative overflow-hidden group shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-white hover:text-black hover:border-white transition-all duration-300 backdrop-blur-md
buttons.magnetic: true (use framer-motion to create magnetic pull effect on hover)

cards.glass: bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.05] backdrop-blur-2xl rounded-2xl p-8 hover:bg-white/[0.04] hover:border-white/[0.1] transition-all
cards.flat: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-zinc-900 p-8 md:p-12 hover:border-zinc-800 transition-colors

inputs.minimal: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 text-white py-4 w-full focus:outline-none focus:border-white transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-600 rounded-none text-lg

motion_and_interactions.cursor: Custom glowing white dot cursor with mix-blend-difference, expanding when hovering over text or interactive elements.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Staggered fade-up and subtle scale-in for images and typography using Framer Motion. Elements appear from bottom.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Background elements, large typography, and images moving at different speeds than scroll.
motion_and_interactions.kinetic_typography: Headlines animate letter-by-letter or word-by-word on entry. Endless marquee scrolling for text banners. Distortion hover effects on large text if possible.

images.description: Abstract white and black fluid painting. Apply opacity 0.2 to 0.4 as hero background overlay to create a 3D metallic liquid feel behind text.
Modern smartphone showcasing a website mockup.
Minimalist black laptop mockup on white textile.
Close up of wireframe sketch for process section.
Black and white abstract fluid painting for service card hover reveals.

media.icons: lucide-react, with 1px to 1.5px stroke-width for ultra-minimalist clean tech feel.

sections_requirements.name: Navigation & Header
sections_requirements.requirements: Fixed/Sticky. Glassmorphism dark background. Logo is placeholder text 'Spynad'. Magnetic links. Must contain 'Get Started' CTA.

sections_requirements.name: Hero
sections_requirements.requirements: Immersive full-screen. Kinetic typography for 'We design websites that don't just look good — they convert'. Glowing primary CTA button. Magnetic secondary CTA. Abstract 3D/fluid background layered behind.

sections_requirements.name: Services
sections_requirements.requirements: Interactive list, accordion, or large horizontal rows. On hover, reveal abstract monochrome background images within the row container, text shifts slightly, cursor interacts.

sections_requirements.name: Why Spynad
sections_requirements.requirements: Asymmetrical layout using Mode A 'Tetris' grid. High contrast metric numbers and abstract geometric image. Lots of negative space.

sections_requirements.name: Portfolio
sections_requirements.requirements: Dynamic grid (e.g. alternating full-width and half-width). Large thumbnails that scale up slowly on hover. Custom cursor text 'View Project' inside circle when hovering images.

sections_requirements.name: Process
sections_requirements.requirements: Step-by-step vertical animated timeline (Discovery -> Launch). A scroll-triggered svg line connecting them.

sections_requirements.name: Branding & Creatives
sections_requirements.requirements: Massive infinite marquee (kinetic text) spanning the screen width. High contrast outline typography (e.g., text-transparent stroke-white).

sections_requirements.name: Testimonials
sections_requirements.requirements: Morphing/sliding large text quotes. No traditional boxes. Giant typography fading in and out, minimal attribution.

sections_requirements.name: Final CTA & Contact
sections_requirements.requirements: Massive kinetic text 'Let's build something people can't ignore'. Minimalist form with thin bottom borders. Lead capture form posting to backend. Glow submit button.

sections_requirements.name: Admin Panel
sections_requirements.requirements: Hidden route '/admin'. Clean, brutalist layout. Login screen followed by dashboard table using Shadcn Table. Pitch black background, pure white text. Data display of contact submissions.
